info.title: Rose SMS Gateway
info.description: HTTP endpoints documented from rose-web-socket/server.js, src/store.js, and src/dispatch-limiter.js. Server domain supplied by the owner; HTTPS deployment and proxy paths have not been verified. POST /sms saves and queues a message and can dispatch it immediately to a connected device; this is not a draft-only save. Use the gateway API_TOKEN for HTTP requests. Device tokens returned by registration authenticate the device WebSocket connection only. No live SMS or device registration was performed.

post.description: Registers a unique device ID and generates a random 64-character hexadecimal device token. Store the returned token securely on the device: only its hash is persisted, and the listing endpoint cannot retrieve it. Registration does not connect the device. Connect a native WebSocket client to wss://sms.rosebakeshop.net/device?deviceId=YOUR_DEVICE_ID using Authorization: Bearer DEVICE_TOKEN. Browser WebSocket clients cannot supply this custom handshake header. The HTTP bearer credential remains API_TOKEN, not the device token. JSON request body limit is 16384 bytes.

401.description: Missing or incorrect gateway API bearer token.

201.description: Device registered; save the token from this response.

400.description: Invalid JSON/object, invalid device ID, or blank/oversized name.

409.description: The device ID is already registered.

post.summary: Save and queue an SMS for sending
post.description:
Persists an outbound SMS, then attempts dispatch to a connected device when its dispatch cooldown permits. Omit deviceId for automatic routing; supply a registered ID to target one device. Offline or cooldown-delayed messages remain queued.

### Dispatch pacing
Each device has at least 3 seconds between dispatch attempts (at most 20 SMS jobs per minute), with only one outstanding job per device. A slow modem or delayed result can reduce throughput further. Queued jobs resume automatically; the service checks dispatch opportunities every second. The process also waits 3 seconds after startup, and per-device cooldowns survive device reconnects within that process. Failed/unknown attempts consume a dispatch slot; result replays and duplicate API requests do not create another dispatch slot for the same job. This is an in-memory, single-process dispatch limit, not an HTTP request limit: accepted jobs are queued, not rejected with 429 because of device cooldown. It limits jobs, not multipart SMS segments or confirmed handset delivery.

### Request deduplication
requestId identifies one logical send: repeating the same requestId, to, body, requested deviceId, and source metadata returns the existing message (200); changing recipient, body, requested device, or source metadata for that ID returns 409. JSON body limit is 16384 bytes. Do not retry an ambiguous send with a new requestId.

### Status
202 confirms persistence/acceptance, not immediate dispatch or delivery. Status sent means the device reports successful sending, not recipient delivery. unknown indicates sending was not confirmed and is never automatically resent; a later device result can resolve it. Use GET /sms/{messageId} to inspect current status.

### Source metadata
Optional JSON fields are source (up to 100 Unicode code points), sourceId (up to 200), and sourceRequestType (up to 100). Values must be nonblank strings or null; numeric sourceId values must be quoted strings. Omitted fields are stored/returned as null. Use camelCase in requests and responses: source_id and source_request_type are database column names, not the API field names. Source values are stored unchanged, not trimmed. Multiple SMS jobs can share the same source metadata; requestId remains the global unique logical-send key. Reusing requestId with changed source metadata returns 409; omitted and null metadata are equivalent. Source metadata is persisted but is not sent to devices in the sms.send WebSocket command.

withSourceMetadata.summary: SMS with originating application and record

401.description: Missing or incorrect gateway API bearer token.

202.description: New message persisted and accepted into the queue. Dispatch may wait for an online device, its current job, startup cooldown, or the 3-second per-device dispatch interval. Not a delivery confirmation.

200.description: Identical requestId and payload already exist; returns the current persisted message without creating another job. Its status can be queued, dispatched, sent, failed, or unknown.

400.description: Invalid JSON, non-object JSON, or invalid request fields. requestId must be 1-200 ASCII characters from ! through ~ (no spaces). Source fields must be null or nonblank strings within their respective limits.

value.error: Provide requestId (1?200 printable ASCII characters), to (+ international number), body (1?1600 characters), and optional deviceId
source, sourceId, and sourceRequestType must be null or non-blank strings of at most 100, 200, and 100 characters respectively

404.description: The requested deviceId does not exist.

409.description: requestId already exists with different recipient, body, requested device, source, sourceId, or sourceRequestType. Omitted and null source values compare equally.

example.error: requestId already used for another message

get.summary: Get a saved SMS and its current status

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: Message id returned by POST /sms; not requestId.

401.description: Missing or incorrect gateway API bearer token.

404.description: No message exists with this ID.

get.description: Returns the current persisted message. Messages can remain queued while waiting for a connected device, its outstanding job, or the dispatch cooldown (at least 3 seconds between attempts per device). Response includes source, sourceId, and sourceRequestType (null when absent).

gatewayBearer.description: Gateway API_TOKEN configured on the SMS server. Paste the token only. This is separate from documentation Basic Auth, Keycloak tokens, and device WebSocket tokens.

id.description: Unique ID with letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only.

name.description: Must contain non-whitespace characters. The server checks JavaScript string length (UTF-16 code units).

token.description: Newly generated device credential. Returned at creation; keep private.

requestId.description: Stable unique logical-send identifier. Printable ASCII without spaces. Reuse only with identical payload.

to.description: International phone number starting with +, followed by 7-15 digits; first digit nonzero.

body.description: Nonblank message, at most 1600 JavaScript UTF-16 code units. Device/modem limitations may be stricter.

deviceId.description: Optional registered device ID. Omit for automatic routing; null is not accepted.

source.description: Originating application, such as branch_ordering. Optional/null allowed; whitespace-only strings rejected. Unicode code-point limit 100. Stored unchanged.

sourceId.description: Originating business record ID as a string, including numeric IDs. Optional/null allowed; whitespace-only strings rejected. Unicode code-point limit 200. Database column source_id; API uses camelCase sourceId.

sourceRequestType.description: Originating request/event type, such as order_ready. Optional/null allowed; whitespace-only strings rejected. Unicode code-point limit 100. Database column source_request_type; API uses camelCase sourceRequestType.

deviceId.description: Assigned device ID, otherwise requested device ID; null if neither is selected.

status.description: queued: awaiting an eligible connected/idle device and dispatch cooldown; dispatched: command sent, awaiting device result; sent: device reported sending (not recipient delivery); failed: device reported failure; unknown: confirmation missing or ambiguous, never automatically resent.

source.description: Persisted source metadata, returned by POST /sms and GET /sms/{messageId}; null when not provided. Originating application, such as branch_ordering. Optional/null allowed; whitespace-only strings rejected. Unicode code-point limit 100. Stored unchanged.

sourceId.description: Persisted source metadata, returned by POST /sms and GET /sms/{messageId}; null when not provided. Originating business record ID as a string, including numeric IDs. Optional/null allowed; whitespace-only strings rejected. Unicode code-point limit 200. Database column source_id; API uses camelCase sourceId.

sourceRequestType.description: Persisted source metadata, returned by POST /sms and GET /sms/{messageId}; null when not provided. Originating request/event type, such as order_ready. Optional/null allowed; whitespace-only strings rejected. Unicode code-point limit 100. Database column source_request_type; API uses camelCase sourceRequestType.
